Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَفِّرْ فِيْهِ حَظِّيْ مِنْ بَرَكَاتِهِ
Translation: O Allah, increase my share of its blessings
And ease my path towards its goodness
And do not deprive me of the acceptance of its good deeds
O Guide to the clear truth
